The surroundings of Da Lat are so diverse that one day is simply not enough to see everything. No matter which direction you go, you'll find panoramic hard tracks, cliffs, and mirror-like lakes. We decided to go on this enduro tour in Nha Trang together with my father. He has a lot of experience, and I have almost zero. I was worried, but in just 1-2 hours, Andrey taught me the basics.

We really went for it — riding through the jungle, rocky trails, and hills with stunning views of the coast. This adventure set the tone for our entire trip! I highly recommend Andrey; he truly opened up the world of enduro to us.

My wife, Yulia, gave me this tour in Nha Trang as a birthday present. Boris, the coach, didn’t mind our lack of experience. He spent an hour training us, and then made a bold decision: he took Yulia as his second rider on his bike.
Together, we covered about 60 km of rough terrain, including rocks and steep jungle inclines. Every second is etched in my memory. This outing to the wild coastal hills is worth more than any price!

Do you offer any tool sets, tire repair kits, or basic tools for the trips?
Here is the information on each item:
-Coffers: Unfortunately, there are no cofers. For long-distance trips, we have experience in securely securing luggage on the trunk using slings.

-Wheel repair kit and a minimum set of tools: Since we mainly drive around the vicinity of Nha Trang, we can provide assistance through local services if needed. However, if it is crucial for your peace of mind, we can provide a minimum set of tools and a wheel repair kit.

Experience: We always recommend taking a rope with you on a trip. In our practice, there were cases (for example, a chain break) when this helped to easily tow the motorcycle to the nearest repair service without difficulties.

Of course! We welcome all riders, regardless of experience level. In just one day, you'll master the basics and be ready to explore Nha Trang's stunning landscapes on your own. We assure you that you'll gain the confidence to ride freely!⚡️
What gear is provided with the tour package?

The rental price includes an enduro motorcycle and a protective helmet. We advise wearing comfortable, closed-toe shoes that you don't mind getting dirty. Also, opt for shoes with laces. Slippers are not suitable.
Do I need an international driving license for Nha Trang Motorcycle Tours?
Although a license is formally required, Nha Trang is an enduro tourist hub. Local authorities do not stop tourists on enduro motorcycles. We can ride safely without any concerns💫
What should be left as collateral?
You can either leave a deposit of 200💲 or use your passport as a guarantee for minor repairs in Nha Trang Motorcycle Tours: Enduro trip through jungles and cliffs | Enduro-Vietnam.
Who is responsible for motorcycle repairs and damages?
Anything that occurs due to the client's error (falls, damage) will be the client's responsibility for payment upon repair.
Can you provide any city-related advice (other than rental)?
Absolutely! We will gladly be your local guide in Nha Trang. Discover stunning landscapes, taste delicious local cuisine, explore vibrant bars, and attend exciting events with us!
Does the Tour around Dalat include a visit to the waterfalls?

Of course! Our routes include the coolest natural spots in Dalat. We often drive right next to the iconic Datanla and Elephant Waterfalls, as well as take a look at Kau Dat Tea Hill. We can even stop by Chuk Lam Monastery for a quick overview. It will be an unforgettable Tour of the surroundings of Dalat! 🏞️🏍️
Do you only offer enduro trips, or are there other exciting experiences?

First of all, we are experts in enduro motorcycles and off-roading. If you're looking for an adventurous ride, we highly recommend our Nha Trang Motorcycle Tours, where you can explore the breathtaking jungles and cliffs. 🏍️🌄
Is it possible to combine an enduro tour with a coffee tour?

Yes, this is a fantastic idea! We are excited to offer you the Nha Trang Motorcycle Tours, where you'll embark on an enduro trip through stunning jungles and breathtaking cliffs. Experience the thrill of the ride and the beauty of Vietnam's landscapes with us! 🏍️🌄
How is your Enduro Tour (Easy Rider) different from Enduro Tour+?

The difference is huge! An Enduro Tour (Easy Rider) is when you're being driven by a guide. Our tour is your personal adrenaline rush! You're in control of the dirt bike (Enduro), and we'll tackle the most challenging off-road trails together. It's an active, self-paced adventure! 🤘🚦
What is the weather in Nha Trang by month? When is the best time to visit for motorcycle tours?

The weather in Nha Trang is typically warm and inviting, making it perfect for adventure. While it can experience sudden showers, there's often a clear window to enjoy the thrilling Enduro tours through jungles and cliffs. We suggest setting off early to make the most of your ride! 🏍️🌄
Do you only rent out enduro motorcycles, or do you also offer motocross rentals?

Our main focus is on enduro motorcycle tours in Nha Trang, featuring thrilling trips through jungles and along cliffs. While we don't rent cross-country motorcycles, we can connect you with trusted local providers. Please note that prices may vary. Looking for a barbecue or outdoor cooking options? Just let us know! 😉💸
